_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score and F&G sit in the Disbelief band with flat funding, dead ETF impulse, and a coil base rate that favors HOLD until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase but outflow print does not contradict range-bound caution
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~48-62, funding near flat, BTC range-bound with no ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >70 with ETF inflows and rising funding (up into Hope), or VIX/dvol spike with price breakdown and negative funding (down into Complacency)
